lede: Navy carries the stronger underlying team rating — -0.9 against -6.5, a 5.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Air Force -1.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Air Force winning 50% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 81% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
